==Russian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|ru|бѣ́гать||ru-PRO}}

===Etymology===
{{root|ru|ine-pro|*bʰegʷ-}}
{{inh+|ru|sla-pro|*běgati}}, from {{der|ru|ine-pro|*bʰegʷ-}}, cognate with {{cog|lt|bėgti}} and {{cog|grc|φέβομαι||to flee}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|бе́гать}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-бегать.ogg}}
* {{audio|ru|LL-Q7737 (rus)-Tatiana Kerbush-бегать.wav|a=Saint Petersburg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|бе́гать|impf|pf=побе́гать|vn=бе́гание|vadj=бе́глый}}

# to [[run]]

====Usage notes====
* {{U:sla:directional verb|ru|multi|impf=бе́гать|pf=побе́гать|othimpf=бежа́ть|othpf=побежа́ть}}
* The compounds of {{m-self|ru|бе́гать}} are formed from {{m|ru|-бега́ть}}.

====Conjugation====
{{ru-conj|impf-intr|1a|бе́гать}}

====Derived terms====
* ''See {{m|ru|бежа́ть}} for derived verbs.''

==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{ety|ru|:inh|orv:правити}}

==Russian==

===Etymology===
From {{af|ru|про-|ходи́ть}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|проходи́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-проходить.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|проходи́ть|impf|pf=пройти́}}

# to [[pass]], to [[go]], to [[walk]]
#* {{RQ:RSB|Mark|2|23|И случилось Ему в субботу '''проходить''' засеянными полями, и ученики Его дорогою начали срывать колосья.|t=And it happened that He '''was passing''' through the grainfields on the Sabbath, and His disciples began to pluck heads of grain along the way.}}
# to [[pass by]]
# ''(time)'' to [[pass]], to [[go by]], to [[elapse]], to [[slip by]]
# to [[be over]]
# ''(meeting, gathering)'' to [[go off]], to be [[held]]
# to [[study]]
